title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 2: Rosters & Varsity Team Manager
overview: Full team/player roster CRUD with multi-team assignment, encrypted PII, registration approval workflow, Discord role sync via bot notification queue, match/stat tracking, leaderboard, announcements, CSV import/export, and an immutable audit log. All endpoints require @api_auth_required.

data_files.data/rosters.json: Master player list. PII fields (purdue_email, personal_email, puid, phone, hometown, year_in_school, gpa, major, jersey_details, additional_notes, schedule_images) are Fernet-encrypted into an 'encrypted_pii' blob; decrypted transparently on load_rosters(), re-encrypted on save_rosters().
data_files.data/.roster_encrypt_key: Binary Fernet key, auto-generated on first run.
data_files.data/teams.json: Team definitions: name, game, type, color.
data_files.data/roster_audit_log.json: Immutable append-only log of all roster modifications, capped ~500 entries.
data_files.data/match_history.json: Logged match results + per-player game stats (kills/deaths/assists/mvp).
data_files.data/team_role_settings.json: Discord role ID mapping used by role sync.
data_files.data/team_announcements.json: Team-wide announcements incl. Discord webhook URLs.
data_files.data/discord_notification_queue.json: Thread-safe append queue read by the LionByteGG bot for async Discord actions.
data_files.data/job_progress.json: Progress tracker for long-running jobs (bulk role sync, bulk DM).
data_files.data/varsity_registrations/{discord_id}_: Per-user list of submitted registration forms.

multi_team_model.team_ids: list on each player, replaces old single team_id (kept for backward-compat = first team)
multi_team_model.coach_rule: player_type == 'coach' can belong to multiple teams and keeps the 'coach' type regardless of team
multi_team_model.non_coach_rule: Inherits the team's type (varsity/jv) for each team assignment
multi_team_model.auto_migration: A player with only team_id gets it converted to team_ids on first access

flow: Admin assigns team_ids via /api/rosters/assign-team (queues immediate sync too)
Admin can queue a full bulk sync via /api/rosters/sync-roles/execute
LionByteGG bot processes it, updates job_progress.json with live progress/errors/rate-limit info

core.does: Loads players + teams + pending registrations with Discord member enrichment (avatar/username)

player_management.does: Toggle captain status for a player

team_management.does: Removes team + clears player assignments referencing it

player_team_assignment.does: Coaches keep type; non-coaches inherit team tier; queues an immediate role-sync notification

registration_approval.does: Queues a varsity form DM to the bot, returns job_id for polling
Decrypts submitted form, adds player to roster, queues Discord role assignment
Marks denied with reason, queues denial DM

matches_and_stats.does: Log a match with per-player stats (kills/deaths/assists)
Leaderboard-style data + recent form for one player

role_sync.does: Read-only preview of exactly which roles would be added/removed
Queues the bulk sync job (supports game/type filters), returns job_id

announcements_and_comms.does: Configure webhook URLs + notification type toggles
Test Discord webhook delivery with an embed
Queues a bulk DM to selected players

notes.one_time_migration: migrate_rosters_pii() encrypts any legacy plaintext PII found on first run after this feature shipped
notes.job_progress_fields: status(queued|in_progress|completed|failed), completed_operations, added_count, removed_count, skipped_count, errors[], current_step, rate_limit info
